items.title: Admin Role
items.description: Members with this role can use Admin Role moderation commands. Public commands remain open to everyone; Owner-only commands require the selected Owner. This setting does not grant additional Root permissions.

items.title: Owner
items.description: Select exactly one community member who can use owner-only commands, including !ban, !unban, !setmodchannel, !setlogchannel, !spamconfig, !levelconfig, and !filter. This setting does not grant additional Root permissions.

items.title: Spam Timeout Role
items.description: Optional temporary role Debo applies after a spam trigger. Configure this role to deny sending messages in the channels you want protected; without it, Debo still deletes the member's messages during the timeout.
